ini_comment: Enhancements unique to NCO (not found in original game)
comment: Toggles for new features and enhancements to the game engine.

rules.name: AStarPathFinding
rules.comment: Use an A* path finding algorithm to move units around the map; less dumb and more logical than original method used in C&C. Ported from the CFEPatch - see: https://bitbucket.org/cfehunter/cncremastered/src/cfepatch/

rules.name: RallyPoints
rules.comment: Barracks, Hand of Nod, Weapons Factory etc. support setting rally points for produced units TS/RA2 style. Ported from the CFEPatch - see: https://bitbucket.org/cfehunter/cncremastered/src/cfepatch/

rules.name: NewSaveGameFormat
rules.comment: Use the new JSON save game format for cross-platform, backwards compatible and mod friendly saves. Note disabling this will use the old binary save format, which doesn't support save/load of Scenario Rules or Lua Scripts.
